## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Add an environment-backed default for `--exclude` so CI jobs can omit matching files through `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`.

## Changes

The pull request adds and documents a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that filters files by basename and logs each skip at INFO level. It adds parser, file collection, and archive tests.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, the parser supplies `[]` and matching files are archived. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` says “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment will archive files they intended to omit.

## Suggestions

- tests/test_main.py:20 — tests — Verify repeated exclusions in the archive — Given `--exclude '*.log' --exclude '*.tmp'`, `test_exclude_is_repeatable` would still pass if `main` forwarded only the first pattern because it checks the parser’s list. — A regression could leave `.tmp` files in the archive while all added tests pass. — Fix: Extend `test_main_leaves_excluded_files_out_of_the_archive` to exercise both flags in one invocation.
